answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. Each agent locks a 40-unit deposit in a vault before trading, and every epoch three random peers audit its work, such as saffron shipments routed through a canyon pass. A fake must fund a deposit, forge a history, and survive unpredictable audits, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 units, while an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps undiluted rewards. Failed audits slash the deposit and flag linked accounts.
